description: Abstract class for generating Java and Native Event code, handling enum and dependency processing within a code generation framework.

classes.name: EventCodeProducer
classes.description: Base class for generating Java and Native Event code, providing methods to retrieve enums and dependencies related to event generation.

methods.name: getEnumsToGenerate
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumDefWrapper objects that should be generated as part of the event, filtering enums in the event section that haven't been generated yet.

methods.name: getEventDependencies
methods.description: Returns an iterator over wrappers that are dependencies for event generation, filtered by whether native or Java code is being generated.

methods.name: scanWrappersForDependencies
methods.description: Helper method to filter wrappers based on section and language mask, adding relevant wrappers to the target list.
